probe.title: Instrumentation probe (example diagnostics)
probe.description: Not part of triage, and deliberately not in the intake wizard. These switches make the example emit the things the platform's redaction and logging guarantees are stated over: its own span attribute, a logging line, a print(), a write to sys.stderr, a logging.exception() traceback, and an attempt to attach a log handler mid-invocation. This is how the acceptance drives an in-process agent.
